subject: POC success plan, ownership & exec window
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@kinetichealth.com>; Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@kinetichealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 16:08:00 +0000
Subject: POC success plan, owners, and proposed timeline

Thanks again for the discovery session earlier today — great context on your ingestion volumes and the two evaluation vectors (clinical note extraction and triage assistant). I promised to share a concise POC plan and a suggested cadence so our teams can align on scope and decision gates. Attached: kinetic-poc-success-criteria-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) and a short evaluation matrix (trial-eval-matrix.pdf).

Summary (short):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for Clinical Note Extraction accuracy and triage assistant latency under realistic (de-identified) traffic.
- Duration: 3-week trial (pilot staging) + 1 week for final readout and exec decision
- Key success criteria (proposed):
  * Extraction F1 >= 0.86 on your labeled holdout (precision/recall trade-offs documented)
  * Triage assistant 95th percentile latency < 400ms for median request shape
  * No PII leakage in outputs; audit log completeness for all inference calls
- Evaluation plan: weekly checkpoints for quality & perf; consolidated quantitative readout at end of week-3; executive summary for decision week.

Owners (proposal):
- Kinetic Health: Oliver Grant (product sponsor), Sara Nguyen (eng lead), Eng team (integration + labeling)
- Redwood: Jasmine Liu (AE / day-to-day), Marissa Cole (CSM / trial orchestration), Dev Patel (runtime engineer - infra & KV cache), Rishi Malhotra (AE Manager - exec alignment)

Next steps (please confirm):
1) Confirm the three success criteria above or propose modifications by EOW (Fri 17 Jul).
2) Provide a minimal sample of de-identified notes and a small labeled holdout (instructions in the attached spreadsheet).
3) Pick a 1-hour slot the week of Jul 27 for the final executive readout (we're proposing Jul 29 or Jul 30 between 10:00-15:00 ET).

I can update the attached plan if you want different metrics (e.g., latency SLOs at p95 vs p99) — callouts welcome.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: kinetic-poc-success-criteria-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet); trial-eval-matrix.pdf
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@kinetichealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@kinetichealth.com>, Eng Team <eng@kinetichealth.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC success plan, owners, and proposed timeline

Thanks Jasmine — the plan looks sensible. Quick notes from our side after internal sync: 

- Success criteria: we agree on extraction F1 and audit logs. For latency, can you also include a p99 target (p99 < 700ms) in addition to p95? Our triage UI surfaces the worst-case tail and we need to bound it.
- Data: we'll provide a 5k-sample de-identified bundle and a 500-example labeled holdout by Mon 20 Jul. 
- Stakeholders: add Linda Park (Chief Medical Officer) to the exec readout invite — she'd like to see value vs clinical risk.
- Compliance: we need an explicit statement on data handling (where logs are retained and how long); procurement will want that in the readout pack.

Availability for final readout: Jul 29 14:00 ET looks best for the exec group. Can you tentatively pencil that?

Oliver
Senior Product Manager | Kinetic Health
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@kinetichealth.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@kinetichealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC success plan, owners, and proposed timeline

Oliver — thanks, this is helpful. Confirming updates and next actions below. I'm also attaching an updated single-page summary (drive link included).

Updates applied:
- Latency: added p99 < 700ms as a secondary SLO; primary acceptance remains p95 < 400ms. See row 4 in the attached spreadsheet.
- Compliance: added a Data Handling appendix (section 3) that spells out log retention (default 30 days, configurable), KMS key usage, and temporary staging bucket policy. Procurement reviewers should be able to use this in the packet.
- Execs: Linda Park added to the readout invite draft.

Deliverables & owners (confirmed):
- Data bundle & labeled holdout — Kinetic (Oliver / Sara) by Mon 20 Jul (you mentioned this is on track).
- Trial infra & runtime config — Dev Patel (Redwood) by Wed 22 Jul.
- Weekly quality checkpoint (start Tue 21 Jul) — Marissa to lead.
- Final consolidated readout deck — Jasmine + Marissa (Redwood) by Thu 29 Jul morning.

Tentative readout: Jul 29 at 14:00 ET — pencil confirmed. I'll send a calendar invite to Linda, Oliver, Sara, Rishi, Marissa, and Dev.

Action items for you to confirm in reply:
- Approve p99 target addition (yes/no)
- Confirm procurement point of contact (name + email) so we can include them in the readout packet

Thanks — I'll update the spreadsheet and re-upload.

Best,
Jasmine
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: POC success plan, owners, and proposed timeline

Quick note from my side — plan looks good and aligns with what I want to see before we commit to a commercial term. A couple of practical points for the readout: 

- Exec window: Jul 29 14:00 ET works for me. Let's hold 45 minutes and aim to leave time for an immediate go/no-go vote.
- Decision rubric: propose we use a simple green/amber/red scale with binary go/no-go if green. Amber would mean additional technical work and a contract milestone to remediate. Red means stop. We should circulate the rubric with the readout deck so execs have a pre-read.
- Commercial next step: if green, we should have a draft term sheet ready (three-line summary of pricing, contract duration, data controls) to circulate in the 48 hours after the readout. Can Jasmine and Marissa coordinate with Finance to have a draft by Jul 31?

I'll join the readout and will bring initial approval authority for the AE manager lane.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Americas Sales | Redwood Inference

See you all on the 29th.
